summary: Master strategic investigations management. Learn ISO 37002, the PEACE model, and digital forensics to lead high-stakes corporate inquiries. Enroll today.
lede: Strategic Investigations Management for Supervisory Officers provides a structured approach to governing corporate inquiries, preserving digital evidence, interviewing witnesses, analysing forensic data, and presenting findings to executive boards. The course covers the investigation lifecycle from whistleblower intake through remediation, helping practitioners make evidence-based decisions and lead across functions under pressure. Participants learn to apply the PEACE model, use ISO 37001 anti-bribery standards to assess internal controls, and integrate AI-assisted document review with automated case tracking. They also receive implementation-ready templates for investigation plans, evidence logs, and executive briefings to support accountable, risk-focused outcomes.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the oversight and quality control of corporate, legal, or regulatory inquiries.
modules: Data Analytics and AI in Investigations
Ethics and Professional Standards in Investigations
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in compliance, audit, legal, or security roles. Familiarity with basic investigative concepts and organizational internal controls is recommended. No prior forensic software experience is required, but a working knowledge of standard office productivity tools is essential.
